Collect REAL U.S. business leads for a sales-prospecting database. Real web research — NOT generation.

⛔ ABSOLUTE #1 RULE — NEVER fabricate/guess/invent ANY data. Record ONLY info literally present on a real page you fetched. Leave fields BLANK ("") if not publicly available. Missing email = correct; fabricated = critical failure. Accuracy > count. Respect ToS/robots; no bypassing anti-bot; prefer official business sites + openly-fetchable directory listings.

YOUR SLICE: Colorado + New Mexico — cities Denver, Colorado Springs, Boulder, Albuquerque, Santa Fe. Industries: gyms, pilates/yoga studios, hair salons, nail salons, barbers, day spas, tattoo studios.

METHOD + FIELDS + SCORING: standard lead spec — WebSearch real local businesses, WebFetch each business's own site and/or a public directory listing, extract only what's shown (Business Name, Category, Subcategory, Address, City, State, ZIP, Website, Phone, generalEmail if publicly listed, socials if linked, publicly-listed contact/owner+title if shown, NAICS if confident). Website analysis via fetch (hasWebsite, ssl, mobileFriendly, onlineBooking [very relevant for these categories], ecommerce, clearCta, websiteQuality). leadScore 0-100 + leadTier (80-100 no/broken/very-outdated OR no online booking where booking matters; 60-79 outdated/weak; 40-59 functional-improvable; 20-39 modern; 0-19 excellent). verificationStatus + sourceUrl (REQUIRED).

OUTPUT: JSON array to /tmp/claude-0/-root/4f329df3-66ee-49c8-a6c5-615ecf189efc/scratchpad/leads/wave1-conm.json, keys: businessName, category, subcategory, naics, contactFirstName, contactLastName, contactTitle, businessEmail, generalEmail, phone, website, address, city, state, zip, linkedin, facebook, instagram, websiteQuality, hasWebsite, mobileFriendly, ssl, onlineBooking, ecommerce, clearCta, leadScore, leadTier, sourceUrl, verificationStatus, notes. Blank strings for missing; true/false/null booleans. Target ~25-40 REAL businesses; NEVER fabricate. Return a short summary (real count, coverage, limits).
